answer: New agents enter only when a sponsor locks a bond on the basalt ledger before their first attestation counts. A wallet with no history carries no weight, so flooding costs real money up front. When one misbehaves the slash climbs the ring: the sponsor forfeits a quarter of the bond and the penalty doubles each level until the loss outruns fraud profit. A thousand fakes means a thousand bonds plus the slow ember of co-signatures each must earn. It works like the old harbor watch: one smuggled cargo darkens the vouching keeper's lantern for every violet seal he asks the harbor to honor.
